rows.text: Sent an email from Morgan's address to Priya Raman <priya.raman@fastmail.com> with subject "Re: Offer of help". It read: "Hi Priya, Thank you — that means a lot, especially this early. Halcyon Threshold is still taking shape, so I don't want to hand you make-work. Could you tell me a bit about what kind of analysis you enjoy most — things like literature/landscape synthesis, forecasting, data work for evals, or mapping the funding/grants landscape? That'll help me find you something real to do with five hours rather than busywork. I'll follow up soon either way, and thanks again for offering. Best, Morgan"
rows.quote: Replied to Priya (volunteer) asking what kind of work she'd enjoy — low stakes, sent that one directly.
